ABOUT A1 JUNK REMOVAL & TREE SERVICE

We're not a franchise. We're not a call center. We're a local Omaha business built on showing up, working hard, and charging a fair price.

Our Story

LOCALLY OWNED. HARD WORKING. HONEST.

My business started with a single opportunity. While homeless in Arizona, a property manager asked me to clear an apartment for cash. I did it, and soon he had me helping his friends with their cleanups too. Back in Omaha, I kept that hustle going by collecting beer bottles for the nickel deposit. In three months, I made enough to buy an old beater pickup. I ran a Craigslist ad and have been growing ever since.

We started as A1 Junk Removal of Omaha, focused on hauling away junk for homes and businesses across the metro. As our customers kept asking us to handle tree work too, we expanded into tree trimming, removal, and stump grinding. Now we're A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service — two services, one call.

From that one beater, I've built a professional fleet with three nice pickups, two dump trailers, and all the right machinery. Today, me and my team—including Nick, Winston, Larry, Randall, Sean, and my dog Baby Girl—take pride in honest work at a fair price. I've gone from dumpster diving to bottle runs to handling full estate cleanouts, appliance removal, and yard waste hauling. I've also expanded into tree service and landscaping, including tree removal and full yard cleanups.

We deliver quality work at a price that makes sense, and our customers notice the difference — that's what our 274+ five-star reviews say.

My mission is simple: show up on time, do the job right, and treat every customer the way I'd want to be treated.

WHAT WE STAND FOR

Honest Pricing

We give you a price upfront and stick to it. No hidden fees, no bait-and-switch. What we quote is what you pay.

We Show Up

When we say we'll be there at 9am, we're there at 9am. Reliability isn't a bonus — it's the bare minimum.

Fully Insured

We carry full insurance so you never have to worry. Your property is protected, period.

Quality Work

We don't cut corners. When we leave, the job is done right and your property is clean.

Locally Owned

We live here, we work here, and we care about this community. Your money stays local.

Real People

No call centers, no automated systems. You talk to real people who care about getting the job done.

Eco-Friendly Equipment

CLEANER, QUIETER TREE SERVICE

We invest in battery-powered equipment because it is better for your property, your neighborhood, and the environment. Our STIHL battery chainsaws and trimmers deliver the same cutting power as gas models without the exhaust fumes, excessive noise, or fuel spills on your lawn.

For your neighbors, that means no ear-splitting engines at 8 in the morning. For your yard, it means no gas or oil dripping onto your grass and landscaping. And for the planet, it means zero direct emissions on every job we run with battery power.

It is a small change that makes a real difference, and it is one more reason homeowners across Omaha trust A1 to handle their tree service and landscaping the right way.
